about: [O7 after the critic, B2] the wanted man and a gun, idle: my revolver out 15 m from him and nothing else - he draws, the gun kit's warning, down: the hospital.

steps.eval: (() => { const b = G.night.bounty.names()[0]; G.stage.part('stream').warmAround(b.x, b.z); const g = G.night.graph(); let px = b.x + 15, pz = b.z; for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) { const a = i * Math.PI / 8, q = new N.THREE.Vector3(b.x + Math.cos(a) * 15, 0, b.z + Math.sin(a) * 15); const q0 = q.clone(); G.stage.colliders.resolve(q, 0.4); if (q.distanceTo(q0) < 0.05 && g.lineOfSight(q.x, q.z, b.x, b.z) && !G.stage.part('city').C.inWater(q.x, q.z)) { px = q.x; pz = q.z; break; } } N.controller.setPose(px, pz, Math.atan2(-(b.x - px), -(b.z - pz)), -0.05); G.stage.part('bounds').navAround(px, pz, 30); return [b.name, Math.round(px), Math.round(pz)]; })()

steps.label: idle with the gun out: he puts me down
down to him: the hospital, the black names him
